note: Deprecated, empty compatibility submodule of Mercury Editor. Ships only mercury_editor_inline_editor.info.yml (no .module, services, routes, config, or permissions); its info.yml states the replacement is mercury_editor_live_edit. It depends on layout_paragraphs and can be enabled/uninstalled but provides no behaviour. Medium/hard cases are grounded in real site state: whether the module is enabled (drush pm:list / moduleExists) and the deprecation notice in its info.yml.

evals.prompt: The Drupal submodule mercury_editor_inline_editor is deprecated. Which project should I use instead for inline/live editing of Mercury Editor components?
evals.expected_output: Use the mercury_editor_live_edit project (drupal.org/project/mercury_editor_live_edit). mercury_editor_inline_editor is a deprecated compatibility shim.

evals.prompt: Does the mercury_editor_inline_editor submodule ship any working code (services, routes, config, permissions) in current Mercury Editor releases?
evals.expected_output: No. It ships only an .info.yml placeholder kept for backwards compatibility; there is no .module, no services, routes, config, or permissions. Enabling it does nothing.

evals.prompt: What module does mercury_editor_inline_editor declare as a dependency in its info.yml?
evals.expected_output: It declares a dependency on layout_paragraphs.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, check the mercury_editor_inline_editor module: is it currently installed/enabled, and according to its own module info what should be used instead?
evals.expected_output: It is enabled on the site (drush pm:list shows it Enabled), and its info.yml deprecation notice says to use mercury_editor_live_edit instead.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, install (enable) the mercury_editor_inline_editor module so that it is active. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: Enable the module, e.g. drush en mercury_editor_inline_editor -y. Afterwards \Drupal::moduleHandler()->moduleExists('mercury_editor_inline_editor') is TRUE.
